take_homes: What I tell the model first changes every answer after it, and I can check that in two minutes by asking the same question with and without a first message.
The agent grades its own work too kindly. Use a fresh reader and trust my own read over its report.
Lessons can be saved in a rules file that the next session reads, so I don't repeat myself.

misconception.why: The context demo was something I could test myself, and the course admitted the tool flatters its own work. That is not how the last three programmes talked. But the filler notes still read like them, so I am only shaken, not turned.

one_line: Two real, testable things in there, buried under copy-pasted programme paragraphs I've seen in three transformations already.
